conviction_note: Q3 harvest volume and price were pre-released on 2026-10-08, so the move is in the forward lines: the first 2027 harvest guide is likely (the Q3 2025 report introduced the 2026 guide) and the ~6,000t 2026 guide needs a ~1,694t Q4 that the October update did not reaffirm. abs_move goes up to 6.0 for a probable first guide. p_up 43 because the lean is an inference from primary numbers and this name has fallen on 10 of its 13 observed results days. The findings sum (-1.7) is larger than the scaled number (-0.84) because each finding is sized on its own and the sign uncertainty is carried in p_up rather than in the findings.

already_public.what: Q3 2026 operational update: 1,596t HOG harvested at ~NOK 65/kg all-in, 94% superior share, net biomass growth 1,984t LW, average harvest weight 3.0kg because one underperforming Phase 1 group (~25% of tank capacity) was harvested out; Q4 Phase 1 harvest weights guided to the mid-to-high end of 3-4kg; Phase 2 targeted run-rate by mid-2027. The update does not restate the 2026 harvest guide. Stock -3.51% that day.

2026 harvest guidance cut from 7,000t to ~6,000t HOG in the Q2 report; Q2 farming cost 70.7 NOK/kg, cash NOK 280.6m, NIBD NOK 2,039.7m; total Phase 2 budget up to NOK 2.65bn including NOK 400m of pre-grow-out tanks, with no FID yet
Invitation: the Q3 report is published at 06:30 CET on 28 October, with the presentation at 08:00 CET

new_in_release.expect: A first 2027 harvest guide is likely, because the Q3 2025 report is where the 2026 guide (7,000t) was introduced. The sell-side marker is Arctic's ~11,200t (May 2026). Direction unknown, with a mild lean to undershooting the sell-side, since the first 2026 guide had to be cut by 1,000t.

The 2026 ~6,000t guide needs about 1,694t in Q4 (YTD 4,306t), which would be the second-best quarter ever. A trim to roughly 5,500-5,800t is plausible; that would be negative but small, because only one quarter is left.

Farming cost/kg is the one Q3 line not yet disclosed. It is likely at or above Q2's 70.7 NOK/kg given the 3.0kg harvest weight, against a 65 NOK/kg price, so farming EBITDA is probably negative. Mildly negative and partly flagged already.
Liquidity after Q3 Phase 2 capex, and possibly the pre-grow-out FID with how it is funded. Unknown; an equity component at a depressed price would be negative.
Q4 price and market commentary. Mildly positive: the spot price recovered to ~NOK 70/kg in week 42.

findings.finding: Hitting the ~6,000t HOG 2026 harvest guide requires about 1,694t in Q4 (6,000 minus YTD 1,765+945+1,596 = 4,306t). That is 41% above Q4 2025's 1,203t and close to the record 1,765t of Q1 2026, and the 2026-10-08 operational update does not restate the guide, so a second 2026 trim in the Q3 report is a live risk.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 7,000t to 6,000t cut came with the Q2 report on 2026-08-18; the stock fell 5.31% that day.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is public but nobody has published it: no press or broker item since 2026-10-08 restates the guide or the Q4 volume it implies (search of salmonbusiness/iLaks/e24 returned nothing dated October about SALME). If it were priced, the 2026-10-08 move would have been larger than -3.5% and there would be a visible estimate cut. With one quarter left, a trim mostly matters as a credibility hit to the 2027 guide.
findings.independence: The Q2 report's own cut from 7,000t (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=680021) shows the guide has already slipped once. That is the same issuer, a different document.

findings.finding: The Q3 report is the scheduled slot for a first next-year harvest guide: the Q3 2025 report introduced the 2026 guide of 7,000t (+50%), which then had to be cut to ~6,000t, against a sell-side marker of ~11,200t (Arctic, May 2026) and a company target of run-rate by mid-2027 only.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: On 2025-11-11, the day of the first 2026 guide (7,000t), the stock fell 2.12%.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide does not exist yet. The lean to the downside is an inference: Phase 2 only reaches run-rate by mid-2027 and the first 2026 guide overshot by about 14%, so a cautious guide below the sell-side marker is somewhat more likely than one above it. If the market expected a strong guide, the stock would not sit 23.5% lower over 60 days into the print.
findings.independence: The Arctic marker comes from a different source: https://www.salmonbusiness.com/salmon-evolution-arctic-sees-harvest-weights-and-costs-as-key-factors-after-q1/ (2026-05-06).

findings.finding: Q3 farming cost/kg, the one Q3 line not pre-released, is likely at or above Q2's 70.7 NOK/kg because the quarter harvested an underperforming group at a 3.0kg average (Q2 3.5kg), against a pre-released price of ~65 NOK/kg. That points to a negative farming EBITDA again.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026's net-income miss against consensus (-39m vs -20m, Fearnley/FactSet) came on a day the stock fell 2.68% (2026-05-06).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the company itself flagged the underperforming group and the low harvest weight. What is left is how much worse the cost per kg is, and there is no published consensus to beat.
findings.independence: The Q2 cost base of 70.7 NOK/kg is in https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=680021, the same issuer.

findings.finding: The FID on the NOK 400m pre-grow-out tanks was flagged for H2 2026 and is still open. The NOK 225m pre-grow construction facility covers only the debt portion, and Arctic estimated about NOK 417m of available liquidity at end-2026 against ~NOK 300m of 2027 pre-grow capex. So the Q3 report may carry the FID together with its funding.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The April 2026 NOK 411m placement was announced the same day as the Q1 trading update (2026-04-28, +0.4% that session); the subsequent offering was cancelled on 2026-06-08.
findings.why_not_priced: What the money would buy is about 2,200t of extra capacity on existing infrastructure, which is capital-efficient. The near-term risk is an equity component at roughly NOK 3, against the April placement price. The sign is close to neutral and the probability that it lands in the window is low.
findings.independence: The Q2 report's facility schedule (NOK 225m pre-grow facility, NOK 1,256m of 1,475m grow-out drawn) is at https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=680021.
